technical.summary: Solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and rising RSI across timeframes, but lack of fresh crossover signals, elevated stochastic, weak volume confirmation, and neutral sector backdrop limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: CI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 51 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (39/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak insider conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (225.28) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event today adds binary risk, and healthcare sector faces credit stress in recessionary environment; earnings in 51 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.
